metric: FEA-07-RESIDUAL-2 AC-R4a-3 uiThreadSchedulingGapMs environment sensitivity (r2 R2-001)
why: Review r2 proved the gap assertion is unstable in the default suite: parallel full-suite load pushes the same metric from ~250 ms (idle) to >500 ms. The gap assertion therefore only runs in the dedicated serial perf gate (NEWMANGA_FEA07_PERF=1); the default suite records the value and never asserts it.
measurementShape: 3 sub-runs per measurement, each 4 warmup + 20 measured one-way switches (frozen median p95 gate shape)

parallelFullSuite.note: Independent Review r2 run; the failing assertion was the r1 default-suite gap gate.

isolatedRepeatsUnderLoad.note: 3 of 4 isolated repeats failed the 400 ms gate while the machine was loaded.

idleSerialBaseline.note: Basis of the original 400 ms budget (1.60x, margin 37.64%).
